skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Use a diverse vocabulary at the pre-C1 level, including abstract and academic topics.
Understand long discussions on abstract and unfamiliar topics, using listening strategies effectively.
Explain and justify arguments, understand speakers' intentions, and engage in debates with appropriate attitudes in academic settings.
Develop critical thinking, analytical reasoning, innovative problem-solving, and information technology skills.
Work independently, plan, coordinate, manage resources, assess, and improve learning activities with appropriate attitudes in academic settings.
